Netanyahu, Eisenkot Parties Fail to Form Israeli Government

Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud party and Benny Gantz's National Unity party have concluded talks without reaching an agreement to form a new government in Israel. Gadi Eisenkot, representing Gantz's party, met with Netanyahu to discuss the formation of the government.
